Weekend banana pancakes

Fluffy banana pancakes for slow mornings. Best served warm with maple syrup.

Tiempo 25 minutesRaciones 2

Antes de empezar

Ingredientes

Marca los ingredientes a medida que avanzas.

Lo que necesitarás

  • mixing bowl
  • frying pan

Manos a la obra

Pasos

Prepare the batter

1

Mash banana (1) in a mixing bowl. Whisk in egg (1) and milk (150 ml).

2

Fold in flour (120 g), baking powder (1 tsp) and salt (1 pinch) until just combined.

Cook and serve

1

Warm butter (1 tbsp) in a frying pan over medium heat. Spoon in small rounds of batter and cook for 2 minutes on each side until golden.

2

Serve with maple syrup to taste.

Buena comida. Ingredientes simples. Algo que merece ser compartido.Hecho con Cooklang.
